idea-plugin.name: Compose Multiplatform Wizard
idea-plugin.description:
A project wizard for creating Compose Multiplatform applications. Works in both IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3+ and Android Studio 2025.2+.

Features:

  • Creates ready-to-run projects with Gradle configuration for selected platforms
  • Automatically resolves library versions from Maven Central based on Compose version
  • Generates platform-specific code (Android manifest, iOS Xcode project, Desktop main, Web resources)
  • Sets up optional features like Git repository, test scaffolding, and Hot Reload

Supported Target Platforms:

  • Desktop (JVM): Windows, macOS, Linux applications
  • Android: Native Android apps with Material Design
  • iOS: Native iOS apps via Kotlin/Native (requires macOS with Xcode)
  • Web: Browser apps via Kotlin/Wasm or Kotlin/JS

Note: This is an early release (0.1.0). The plugin is functional but may have rough edges.

Bug reports and feature requests: Submit on GitHub
